name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
benefit_summary: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon attaining 60 years of age, with 50% matching co-contribution by the Central Government.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) guidelines.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook or Jan Dhan Account
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
